name: affiliate-offer
title: Affiliate offer
description: Recruit partners: the commission in big figures, how it works in three steps and one apply action.
docs: Pass title, facts (a value and a label each, three read best), steps (a title and a description each), audience, action and termsHref. This is the public page for people who might become partners, not the screen a customer sees (that is Refer a friend). The facts are a description list set in large figures, the steps an ordered list joined by a line from one number to the next, and termsHref is required and sits right next to the button, because a claim about earnings needs its conditions beside it. The figures share one size, the largest that lets the longest word of any of them fit its cell, so four or five of them never break a word. audience says who the programme suits in one sentence. From 768px the facts run in a row and the steps sit side by side; under that both stack and the line runs down. Nothing animates. eyebrow and description are optional; labels translates the terms link and the names of the two lists.
